title: Veterans Pension Net Worth Limit and Asset Transfer Penalty Terms
content:
# Net worth and asset transfer terms — Veterans Pension

These terms are identical in all six rate categories: Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, No Dependents), (Basic Rate, One Dependent), (Housebound, No Dependents), (Housebound, One Dependent), (Aid and Attendance, No Dependents) and (Aid and Attendance, One Dependent).

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Net worth limit (assets plus annual income) above which no pension is payable | USD 163699 |
| Annual countable income added to assets when net worth is measured | Yes |
| Residential lot excluded with the primary residence | up to 2 acres |
| Look-back period for a transfer of a covered asset for less than fair market value | 36 months before the date of claim or report |
| Monthly penalty rate (the divisor that sets the penalty period) | USD 2873 |
| Longest penalty period | 60 months |
| Rounding of the computed penalty period | down to the whole month |
| Transfer to a trust for a child who cannot self-support | exempt from penalty |
| Reapplication once net worth falls to or below the limit after a denial or termination for net worth | permitted |

## Limit — both sides (hypothetical figures)

| Net worth | Position against the 163699 limit |
|---|---|
| 163699.00 | at the limit — not above it |
| 163699.01 | above the limit |

## Penalty period — figures worked (hypothetical covered amounts)

| Covered amount | Divided by 2873 | Rounded down | Capped at 60 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20000.00 | 6.96 | 6 months | 6 months |
| 2872.00 | 0.99 | 0 months | 0 months |
| 200000.00 | 69.61 | 69 months | 60 months |
